name: Minang Geopark Run 2026
short_description: Minang Geopark Run 2026 is a half-marathon held on November 1, 2026, in Bukittinggi, Sumatera Barat, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Minang Geopark Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for November 1, 2026, in Bukittinggi, Sumatera Barat, Indonesia. Organized by the Geopark Run Series, it takes place around the Jam Gadang and Ngarai Sianok area, offering three distance options: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. Registration for the event is currently open to participants.

core_facts.venue: Jam Gadang / Ngarai Sianok area, Bukittinggi

pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km) suit different runner levels
Scenic venue around Jam Gadang and Ngarai Sianok landmarks
Organized by an established event series, Geopark Run Series

research_highlights: Three distance categories offered: 5K, 10K, and 21K, with cut-off times of 1.5 hours (5K), 2.5 hours (10K) and 4 hours (21K) in the 2025 edition
Course runs through the Ngarai Sianok geopark area and past the Jam Gadang clock tower landmark, mixing urban city streets with hilly geopark terrain

Draws strong turnout from running communities: the 2023 edition had roughly 1,500 runners with 92% from outside Bukittinggi and over 50 running communities joining, while the 2025 edition drew about 3,500 runners, mostly from Riau province
Race pack collection and race day are typically split over a Friday/Saturday collection window before a Sunday race morning start at Jam Gadang square
2025 entry fees were roughly Rp250,000-300,000 for 5K, Rp400,000 for 10K, and Rp450,000 for 21K
research_watchouts: The 2025 edition was postponed from its original date (from Nov 30, 2025) due to severe flooding and landslides affecting West Sumatra, showing the event's schedule can be weather/disaster-dependent
Local coverage describes the route as including climbs ('tanjakan') and descents typical of Bukittinggi's hilly terrain, so runners are advised to train on inclines beforehand
Venue details for race-pack collection have in some editions been listed as 'TBA' relatively close to race day

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Minang Geopark Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Minang Geopark Run 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 5km run, a 10km run, and a 21.1km half-marathon, which is the event's primary distance. This range allows both casual runners and more experienced half-marathoners to take part in the race.

faqs.question: When and where does the Minang Geopark Run 2026 take place?
faqs.answer: The Minang Geopark Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on November 1, 2026. The event will be held in the Jam Gadang and Ngarai Sianok area of Bukittinggi, located in Sumatera Barat, Indonesia, offering runners a scenic backdrop for the race.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Minang Geopark Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Minang Geopark Run 2026 is organized by the Geopark Run Series, which oversees the planning and hosting of this half-marathon event in Bukittinggi, Sumatera Barat, Indonesia, featuring courses that pass through notable local landmarks such as Jam Gadang and Ngarai Sianok.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Minang Geopark Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Minang Geopark Run 2026 is currently open. Interested participants can sign up for any of the three available distances -- 5km, 10km, or the 21.1km half-marathon -- ahead of the event taking place on November 1, 2026, in Bukittinggi, Indonesia.
